title: StockGPT thoughts
author: stockwarrior1
selftext:
Hi all,

Life's been rather buy recently, so I have been looking for a tool to speed up the process for finding stocks, with higher accuracy. Quant (ish) level analysis just takes so long. Fed up of going through 10-K's and Q's most importantly. I stumbled across [www.stockgpt.pro](http://www.stockgpt.pro) a few weeks ago on an advertisement board in London ... it runs a multi-factor ranking algorithm across the S&P500. It factors in fundamental indicators, as well as momentum, PE, PEG, ROE, volatility, amongst others (according to their website.) They they score tall 500 stocks based on these factors from 0-infinity (although I haven't seen a stock go above 50,000). 

My thoughts? It isn't a silver bullet, but it sure is useful. For cutting down a 500 stock watchlist to 20, it wins. Whether it works or not? Well, for ME it has. The general consensus seems to be that it works. My number 1 stock when I first joined happened to be $MU, which has increased by 150% since. It was also nice to see the recent earnings report on Wednesday reinforce what the algorithm was expecting. Saying that, I will need another 5 months use from it to properly decide whether it's worth it. My portfolio it made me is up 50% in the 7 months I've been using it, which is nice. Promising signs nevertheless. Anyway, thought some of you might find it useful.
